categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes `src/streams.h` to make `BufferedWriter::flush()` non-throwing and handle write errors cleanly.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception in `BufferedWriter`'s destructor that triggers `std::terminate` and crashes the node on disk write failures. The author notes that local storage errors such as a full filesystem reliably caused `AutoFile::write_buffer()` to throw and crash during destruction without clean diagnostics.
